about_the_game:
🏕️ About the Game

Legend has it that deep within the “Haunted Woods” lurks an eerie forest where malevolent spirits roam after nightfall. You and your colleagues decide to camp in this forbidden place, but what should have been a fun trip soon spirals into a terrifying nightmare.

As night falls, strange whispers echo around the campfire. A seductive ghost emerges from the shadows, luring you with deadly temptation. Though you barely survive the horrifying escape, one of your companions has already been possessed — and will bring the curse back to the company.

Will you resist the ghost’s deadly seduction and survive? Will you save the colleague you secretly love? Or will you become the next victim?

The outcome depends entirely on your choices and courage.

🎮 Key Features

  • Immersive Horror Experience – Blending urban legends with supernatural terror to deliver a chilling atmosphere.

  • Multiple Endings – Every decision matters: survival, sacrifice, or salvation.

  • Colleague Bonds – Face danger alongside one male and five female colleagues. Friendships and romance may determine your fate.

  • Seduction Mechanic – Beware of the ghost’s deadly allure. Succumb, and your life force will be drained.

  • Office Horror Twist – Escaping the forest is only the beginning. The real nightmare follows you back to work.

  • Varied Gameplay – Exploration, puzzles, survival, and branching choices combine for a thrilling horror adventure.

⚠️ Warning

This game contains horror, supernatural, and seductive elements.
Recommended for fans of horror, thriller, and survival experiences.

content_descriptors.notes: Game contains sensitive contents such as partial nudity or sexual content, as well as alcohol use, may not be suitable for all age ranges.
